target: driver series per item: FRED commodity benchmark / CPI computers / curated GPU street index

tuned.objective: train: mean over h3/h6/h12 of pooled |error| / naive |error| - 0.05 x big-rise recall (h6); parsimony tie-break within 0.002

ai_ablation_test.note: AI-driver coefficients are priors (not fitted); gpu cutoffs are anchor months only, so n is small

highlights.story: Chocolate bar (100g): in 2023-11 Orbit v2 gave a 30% chance of a >15% rise (said +5%); it rose +90%.
Latte (London café): in 2024-08 Orbit v2 gave a 31% chance of a >15% rise (said +4%); it rose +57%.
Orange juice (1L): in 2023-05 Orbit v2 gave a 32% chance of a >15% rise (said +0%); it rose +49%.
Olive oil (1L): in 2023-04 Orbit v2 gave a 26% chance of a >15% rise (said +1%); it rose +46%.
Loaf of bread: in 2025-11 Orbit v2 gave a 24% chance of a >15% rise (said +3%); it rose +31%.
High-end GPU: in 2024-10 Orbit v2 gave a 28% chance of a >15% rise (said +5%); it rose +19%.
Honest miss: Chocolate bar (100g) from 2023-10: v2 said +3% (P(>15%) 22%), it went +167%.

final.description: Per-horizon non-negative stack of members that beat naive on VALIDATION (NNLS or equal-weight x shrink, chosen by leave-one-item-out CV on VAL); split-conformal 80% band from point-in-time residual history; P(up)/P(>15%) = VAL-picked mix of conformal and member classifier probabilities. Nothing tuned on TEST.
